Reasoning through language arts

Reading, grammar, and writing: the GED test that asks you to understand texts, edit sentences, and write a short essay that analyzes two arguments. LearnGED will have two paths: reading and writing in English, and reading and writing in Spanish.

Coming soon. This page shows the plan for both paths, so you (and the teachers who review LearnGED) can see what is coming.

  • How it is organized
  • Levels 1 and 2
  • Levels 3 and 4
  • How each lesson works

How it is organized

  • Four levels, like Math. Levels 1 and 2 are part of Build your foundation; Levels 3 and 4 are part of Prepare for the GED. Each level has 8 topics.
  • Two languages, two courses. Unlike Math, the two paths are not translations of each other: English and Spanish have different sounds, spelling, grammar, and punctuation, so each path has its own lessons, texts, and exercises.
  • Reading and writing in Spanish comes from the complete course of GEDparaHispanos (four levels, already finished), adapted to LearnGED.
  • Reading and writing in English is a new course, written from the start for English, with public-domain texts. Its outline below is a draft that follows the same structure; GED teachers who teach in English will review it before the lessons are written.
  • Practice for the extended response will be connected to an essay checker in each language.

Levels 1 and 2 · Build your foundation

Level 1 · Getting started with reading and writing

Reading and writing in English draft

  1. 1 · The alphabet, letter sounds, and print
  2. 2 · Phonics and fluency: short and long vowels, blends, and sight words
  3. 3 · The sentence: nouns, verbs, adjectives, capital letters, and end marks
  4. 4 · Comprehension strategies and everyday vocabulary
  5. 5 · Stories: sequence, characters, cause and effect
  6. 6 · Visual information: signs, forms, maps, and tables
  7. 7 · The paragraph: topic sentence and details
  8. 8 · Communication at work and online; final project

Reading and writing in Spanish 42 lessons

  1. 1 · The alphabet and the direction of reading
  2. 2 · Phonological awareness and fluency
  3. 3 · The sentence: noun, adjective, verb, and punctuation
  4. 4 · Comprehension strategies and vocabulary
  5. 5 · Narrative text and how ideas connect
  6. 6 · Visual information: images, maps, tables, and graphs
  7. 7 · The paragraph and kinds of text
  8. 8 · Communication, technology, and final project

Level 2 · Connecting ideas and texts

Reading and writing in English draft

  1. 1 · Longer words: syllables, prefixes, suffixes, and fluency
  2. 2 · Sentence grammar: pronouns, subject–verb agreement, and verb tenses
  3. 3 · Punctuation, spelling, and formal and informal English
  4. 4 · Main idea, supporting details, and text structure
  5. 5 · Comparing texts, context clues, and figurative language
  6. 6 · Reading graphics, and reading in science and social studies
  7. 7 · Writing with structure: opinion, informative, and narrative
  8. 8 · Speaking, listening, and final project

Reading and writing in Spanish 24 lessons

  1. 1 · Advanced phonics and reading fluency
  2. 2 · Sentence grammar
  3. 3 · Punctuation, spelling, and register
  4. 4 · Main idea and text structure
  5. 5 · Comparing texts, vocabulary, and figurative language
  6. 6 · Reading with images and in the content areas
  7. 7 · Writing with structure
  8. 8 · Speaking, listening, and final project
↑ Back to top

Levels 3 and 4 · Prepare for the GED

Level 3 · Exploring analysis and argument

Reading and writing in English draft

  1. 1 · Advanced grammar: clauses, modifiers, and parallel structure
  2. 2 · Commas, semicolons, apostrophes, and academic vocabulary
  3. 3 · Inference and textual evidence
  4. 4 · Text structure and literary language
  5. 5 · Evaluating arguments and integrating sources
  6. 6 · Reading in the content areas: data, procedures, and multimedia
  7. 7 · Argumentative and informative writing with analysis
  8. 8 · Research, speaking, and final project

Reading and writing in Spanish 24 lessons

  1. 1 · Advanced sentence grammar
  2. 2 · Advanced punctuation and academic vocabulary
  3. 3 · Inference and textual evidence
  4. 4 · Text structure and literary language
  5. 5 · Evaluating arguments and integrating sources
  6. 6 · Reading in the content areas: data, procedures, and multimedia
  7. 7 · Argumentative and informative writing with analysis
  8. 8 · Research, speaking, and final project

Level 4 · Mastering the GED and argumentative writing

Reading and writing in English draft

  1. 1 · Complex sentences and the conventions the GED tests (editing passages)
  2. 2 · Advanced vocabulary and figurative language
  3. 3 · Critical reading: themes and complex inference
  4. 4 · Structure, rhetoric, and style
  5. 5 · Evaluating and comparing arguments (paired passages)
  6. 6 · Reading quantitative and scientific texts
  7. 7 · The extended response: analyzing two arguments
  8. 8 · Extended research, speaking, and GED test preparation

Reading and writing in Spanish 24 lessons

  1. 1 · Complex syntax and expert control of conventions
  2. 2 · Advanced vocabulary and figurative language
  3. 3 · Critical reading: interacting themes and complex inference
  4. 4 · Structure, rhetoric, and style
  5. 5 · Evaluating arguments and synthesizing sources
  6. 6 · Quantitative and scientific analysis in the content areas
  7. 7 · Argumentative and discipline-specific writing
  8. 8 · Extended research, speaking, and GED preparation

How each lesson works

  • Lesson and practice page. Each lesson has its own practice page with activities that make new exercises every time, linked by section.
  • Two tries. First wrong answer: a hint. Second: the solution, explained. Two-choice questions explain right away.
  • GED and CCR standards at the end of each lesson, taken from the official GED Assessment Guide.
  • Accessible. Keyboard navigation, text descriptions for every figure, larger text and high contrast, and nothing to install.
  • Everything on LearnGED. No accounts, no outside sites: the readings, the tools, and the practice live here.
